Hey! We're hiring for a Founding GTM Lead at Skyfall AI.

We are an AI research lab developing Enterprise Foundational Models (EWMs) that can understand, simulate, and act across complex enterprise systems.

And no, this is not the first time we are taking a different approach or building a company from the ground up. Skyfall was founded by the original Maluuba team, pioneers of the deep learning revolution who worked closely with leaders such as Yoshua Bengio and Richard Sutton before Maluuba’s $160M acquisition by Microsoft, where it became Microsoft’s AI research center in Canada.

We are building the next foundation layer for enterprise AI.

Please note, there is no playbook. This is a 0-1 role.

Apply here if you're interested: https://zrec.ca/uMnqA?source=CareerSite
